newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel to begin work on settlement in Jerusalem.
newsitem.headline: Israel to begin work on settlement in Jerusalem.

text.p: Israel will begin work on Tuesday on a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem that has angered Palestinians and drawn worldwide criticism, an Israeli official said.
"The surveyors will start working on Har Homa on Tuesday," Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's communications director David Bar-Illan told Reuters.

The Israeli army declared the area, called Har Homa in Hebrew and Jabal Abu Ghneim in Arabic, a closed military zone. It asked Palestinians who had pitched tents and launched a sit-in at the disputed hilltop on Monday to leave.
Israeli and Palestinian officials were trying to arrange a summit to defuse tensions surrounding Israel's decision to build at the site.

"There were efforts to arrange a meeting tonight between Prime Minister Netanyahu and (Palestinian President Yasser) Arafat and these efforts will continue to arrange a meeting within the next few days," Bar-Illan said.
Israel reinforced its troops in the West Bank and Gaza Strip to pre-empt Palestinian violence when ground is broken this week on the project to build 6,500 housing units for Jews.
